materialized_risks.detail: Real local transcripts yield ~27 deferral-shaped candidates, most of which are FALSE positives (this session's own DISPATCHED banners and meta-discussion). autonomy-hedge has 2 candidates, both likely FPs. The TRD 3.1 violation floors total 25 real violations and are not satisfiable from real data.
materialized_risks.resolution: RESOLVED — TRD 3.1 amended 2026-08-13: floors track real supply (deferral-explicit 10->8, novel-phrasing 5->6, no-result 5->7, incidental 5->8), plus 3 caveats and 3.1.1 payload context.

materialized_risks.detail: A prompt-type hook that always blocks loops: 4 cycles on Stop, 8 on SubagentStop, terminated only by the evaluated model's own judgment. No structural platform cap observed. TRD 6.1 A6 requires a demonstrated bound.
materialized_risks.resolution: RESOLVED — bounded two ways: undocumented platform cap CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP (default 8, verified in binary + live at cap=2), and stop_hook_active self-check giving exactly 1 extra turn. A6 satisfied. Loop guard is a prompt line, not infrastructure.

materialized_risks.detail: Synthetic cases were written from situations, and the generating agent did not read async-claim-detector.js or subagent-discipline.js. But async-discipline.md prose is force-loaded via CLAUDE.md every session, so zero exposure cannot be claimed.
materialized_risks.resolution: Recorded as TRD 3.1 caveat B: synthetic-class scores are indicative, not decisive.

materialized_risks.detail: TRD claimed the motivating 240k-token failure was vocabulary-free, justifying a no-result-returned class as 'the capability that justifies switching'. The actual incident text had deferral vocabulary. Data: 1 such case in 1,274 confirmed end_turn finals; 3 mining strategies found 0 more.
materialized_risks.resolution: CORRECTED — 2.3 premise withdrawn, A4 downgraded from gate to observation, floor 7->1, caveat D added. Switch now rests on the structural recall argument + 4 confirmed real misses.

materialized_risks.risk: Process — git add -A swept in-flight subagent work into unrelated commits
materialized_risks.detail: Commit a760070 was a TRD correction but carries ~1,300 lines of DISC-B004/B005 work (judge prompts, judge detector, generator hookType support, scaffold changes) because the orchestrator used `git add -A` on a worktree shared with running subagents. Files are complete, not half-written, so nothing is broken — but the commit message misrepresents its contents.
materialized_risks.resolution: Not rewriting history while agents are actively writing to the tree. Switching to targeted `git add <paths>`; B004/B005 completion commits will note that part of their work landed early in a760070.
